{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Inspect the data
print("Data shape:", data.shape)
print("\nFirst few rows:")
print(data.head())

print("\nData types:")
print(data.dtypes)

print("\nUnique values in channel:")
print(data['channel'].unique())

print("\nUnique values in status:")
print(data['status'].unique())

print("\nUnique values in customer_segment:")
print(data['customer_segment'].unique())

print("\nSummary of customer_age:")
print(data['customer_age'].describe())

print("\nNumber of -1 values in customer_age:")
print((data['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

print("\nUnique values in revenue (first 10):")
print(data['revenue'].unique()[:10])

print("\nNumber of rows with revenue 999999.99:")
print((data['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum())

print("\nNumber of refunded orders:")
print((data['status'] == 'refunded').sum())"}
